svg.title: Issue 1 — Page 1 — Panel 3: Wren at engineering console
svg.desc: Medium shot, slight high angle looking down at workstation. Wren hunched over engineering console, hands inside copper-gold holographic diagnostic display manipulating floating geometric shapes. Focused, slightly bored — rote work, muscle memory. Warm copper-gold from holographic interface mixing with ambient blue-white overhead. WREN: "Drive nominal. Ninety-seven percent field coherence. We're clean."
